one_liner: Gorgias has a broad REST API with private-app API keys (Basic auth), mandatory OAuth2 for public/3rd-party apps (partner signup and app review), and an MCP server that the supplied pages do not confirm.
auth_notes: The pages confirm OAuth2 is mandatory for 3rd-party apps and that private apps need no approval. The Basic/API key mechanism is not shown on the supplied pages, so it is kept from the draft at low confidence.
access_notes: Public apps need Developer Portal signup and Gorgias review before listing. Private apps need no approval. The pages do not say whether a free or trial account gives API keys; a Gorgias account is presumably paid.
blocker_notes: A multi-tenant OAuth2 app must join the Developer Portal and pass Gorgias review (about two weeks). Per-customer private-app credentials avoid review.

evidence.quote: Using [OAuth2](https://developers.gorgias.com/docs/set-up-oauth2-app-store) is mandatory for any 3rd party app.
For Private apps there is no need for approval.
This step is required only if you plan to build a Public app.
We'll review it within two weeks and let you know if it's approved.
